headline: GREEN: easy 50min done on target, no plan changes. Saturday's long run stays as written
summary: Today's run is graded and locked: 49min, 9.5km, load 47 vs 45 planned, RPE 4, feel 2 (Good). Average HR was 149, inside the 138-150 band, and that figure includes the strides. Max 184 fits 20s strides at 175-185, so the strides were done. Readiness is green. HRV is 70, up 16 from yesterday's 54. RHR is 50 and sleep was 6h30 (score 78). Yesterday's amber reading has cleared. CTL is 55.3 and ATL 65.7, so TSB is -10.4. CTL is already at the 55 start-line target. Week 7 so far: 309 load delivered of 337 planned, Tue to Fri. The gap comes from Thursday's spin, which was dropped on purpose. We are 8 days out, inside the 10-day window where freshness comes first. So there is no +10% push and no edits. Saturday's 170 long run in Presolana stays as written, and the readiness gate applies on the morning.
flags: Saturday's long run: the first 80min are capped at 155bpm. On Sun 25 you spent 77min in Z3-Z4 against about 30 planned. Hiking anything over 15% is part of the session.
Saturday's gate: HRV under 55 or RHR 52+ = 2 climbs only, cap 1h50.
Tonight: carb-forward dinner, bed by 22:00. Sleep, not load, is still what limits you.
